meta.title: K4hveci — Software Developer
meta.description: K4hveci — software developer building Discord bots, backend systems and web projects.

hero.description: I build Discord bots, backend services and web projects with Node.js, PostgreSQL and Linux. I care about code that stays readable, organized and maintainable over time.

about.title: I focus on simplicity, performance and maintainability.
about.lead: I care about more than making a system work; it should stay organized, secure and easy to improve later.
about.body: I mainly work with JavaScript and Node.js. Alongside Discord bots, backend services and web projects, I manage PostgreSQL and Linux infrastructure directly.

projects.title: Projects I am working on.
projects.lead: A collection of the bots and web projects I actively develop. Open a card to see the project details.

listcord.description: A botlist platform designed to make discovering, verifying and listing Discord bots cleaner and more reliable.
features: Product experience centered on bot discovery and listing
Structured submission flow for developers and the community
Soft, premium and minimal interface direction
listcord.longDescription: Listcord is the botlist platform I am building for discovering, listing and connecting Discord bots with communities. I am designing it as more than a directory, with room for submissions, verification, moderation and a durable data layer as the product grows.

vanguardn.description: The main system combining moderation, security and server-management layers in one reliable Discord bot architecture.
features: Long-running Linux deployment and maintainability focus
vanguardn.longDescription: Vanguardn is the primary Discord bot architecture I am building around moderation, security and server management. The focus is stability, security, a shared data layer and clean integration with the rest of the Vanguardn services.

ai.description: A Discord AI assistant that joins conversations naturally when mentioned instead of behaving like a command-only bot.
features: Lightweight response path focused on lower latency
ai.longDescription: Vanguardn AI is designed to participate in Discord conversations when needed, without relying on a classic command-first interaction model. I am building it around provider flexibility, lower response latency and a natural helper experience inside the community.

modmail.description: A structured support flow between users and staff, designed to expand into an appeal system later.
features: Designed to expand into punishment appeals later
modmail.longDescription: Vanguardn ModMail is the support system I am building for communication between Discord community members and staff. The architecture is planned to expand into an appeal flow connected to punishment records from the main moderation system.
